verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows RunAnywhere or its CLI recommending which local model fits a user's hardware and task before download. The docs cover download progress reporting, hardware acceleration (Hexagon NPU, M3 requirement) and a cloud option for models too large for a laptop. These are adjacent features, not a pre-download model recommendation assistant.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
